verdict.rationale: Pylon's Runbooks let admins give the Support Agent natural-language manuals for specific scenarios and complex procedures, and Skills provide reusable instructions so agents handle specific workflows consistently. That covers encoding SOPs per issue type. Nothing shows deterministic, explicitly branched execution: the instructions are natural-language guidance interpreted by the AI, and Triggers are a separate automation feature, not agent SOPs. Missing for 10: deterministic branching logic within agent procedures, documented step-by-step execution guarantees, issue-type routing to specific runbooks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I encode standard operating procedures the agent follows step-by-step for known issue types, with deterministic branching

citations.quote: Write instructions in natural language to help your AI Agent handle specific scenarios.
Give your agents manuals to execute complex procedures.
Skills are reusable instructions that teach Pylon agents how to handle specific workflows consistently.
